gaps.gap: ~33–40 unions missing vs the official 4,571–4,578 (seed has 4,538 after removing 3 duplicates). All unions are community data and not published.
gaps.fix: Import the LGD/BBS union list and reconcile by geocode.

gaps.gap: No record has official (Tier 1) evidence yet; published areas and places rest on secondary sources.
gaps.fix: Verify against LGD/BBS/gazette sources in the admin verification centre.

gaps.gap: Seed and Consolidated Master v3.0 differ in Sirajganj (82 vs 83), Bogura (Gabtali/Sonatala), Rajshahi Bagha (Chakrajapur) and Chapainawabganj (5 names each way).
gaps.fix: See docs/data/UNRESOLVED_CONFLICTS.md; resolve with primary evidence.

gaps.gap: New upazilas Eidgaon, Madhyanagar, Dasar and Guimara have 0 unions; their unions still sit under the parent upazilas (Naldanga fixed Nov 2026 from the Natore district portal).
gaps.fix: Re-parent unions per the creation gazettes.
